paymentResult.paid.title: Payment received
paymentResult.paid.description: We confirmed your payment. You can close this page.
paymentResult.pending.title: We are confirming your payment
paymentResult.pending.description: This can take a few seconds. Please keep this page open.

paymentResult.declined.title: Your last attempt was declined
paymentResult.declined.description: You can try again with the same payment link.

paymentResult.closed.title: This payment link is no longer available
paymentResult.closed.description: The link expired or was cancelled. If you still need to pay, ask for a new one.
paymentResult.voided.title: Payment voided
paymentResult.voided.description: This payment was voided. If you have questions, contact whoever sent you the link.
paymentResult.error.title: There was a problem with this charge
paymentResult.error.description: This payment link could not be completed. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
paymentResult.unknown.title: We could not find this payment
paymentResult.unknown.description: Make sure you opened the full link, or ask for a new one.
paymentResult.network.title: We could not check your payment
paymentResult.network.description: Check your connection and try again.
